Australian media outlets publish identical opinion pieces on accent bias

Two Australian newspapers, The Sydney Morning Herald and The Age, published identical opinion pieces on the topic of accent bias. The article, written from a personal perspective, discusses how the author's accent has likely influenced their experiences. The piece explores the subtle ways in which accents can impact perceptions and opportunities. No specific incidents or individuals are named in the provided coverage, and the focus remains on the general phenomenon of accent-based bias.
